# Alexey Eryshev

> Alexey Eryshev is the founder of Munito AI (https://munito.ai), backed by Y Combinator: an open-model inference provider for Europe, private by default. Before Munito he led inference at Mistral AI, and worked at Airbnb and Meta.

- Munito AI serves open models from Europe behind OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, with zero data retention by default and no training on customer data.
- He believes that open and independent intelligence, both models and inference, is key to economic growth and prosperity.
- Contact: X https://x.com/alexeyeryshev, LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexeyeryshev/. Code: https://github.com/alexeyeryshev.

## Projects

- [Munito AI](https://munito.ai): open models, run in Europe, behind an API you already know how to use.
- [Scriptscore.AI](https://github.com/alexeyeryshev/scriptscore.ai): LLMs that simulate audience groups to predict the success of a show or a movie.
- [YC ideas validator](https://github.com/alexeyeryshev/yc-idea-validator): Idea Validator on the YC winter 2024 batch, with the top 10 ideas.
- [How to relocate to France](https://howtorelocatetofrance.notion.site/): resources for people displaced by the war in Ukraine.
- [Monitoring your cryptocurrencies with Prometheus](https://eryshev.gitlab.io/cryptocurrencies.monitoring.with.prometheus/): a talk at SunnyTech 2018.
- [dotfiles](https://github.com/alexeyeryshev/dotfiles): personal laptop configuration.
